extracted.name: Homemade Baking Mix
extracted.description: A few simple ingredients are all you need to make your own homemade baking mix for biscuits, cobbler, or a million other things.
instruction_lines: Whisk flour, dry milk powder, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a large bowl until thoroughly combined. Cut shortening into dry ingredients with a pastry cutter, about 1/2 cup at a time, until mixture resembles cornmeal. Store in an air-tight container for up to 3 months.
